description: Free. Reports the credit balance of the account this client is connected to, plus what one credit is worth, what each operation costs in credits, the monthly free allowance and whether a card is on file to unlock it. Takes no input: it reads the account behind the credential your client already connected with. If you have a connected account, paid tools are funded from this balance and never present a payment challenge - so call this to find out how much work you can still queue, and top up at the account page named in the answer. Anonymous callers (x402 buyers, who pay per call instead) have no balance and get an unauthorized error; either way nothing here is charged.
name: get_balance
title: Check your credit balance (free)
